title: Registry
description: Registry configuration (.monumentum/registry.yaml, parsed). Team profile only. Normative for spec monumentum/v0.1.

kind.description: v0.1 defines exactly one Distributor kind: a plain git remote. OCI is a specified upgrade path, not implemented in v1.

pubkeys_dir.description: Directory of trusted ed25519 public keys, relative to .monumentum/.

verify.description: Verification settings for pulled ChangeSets. Team-lite: ed25519 detached signatures.

key_file.description: Path to this workspace's ed25519 private key, relative to .monumentum/. MUST NOT be pushed to the registry.

signing.description: How this workspace signs ChangeSets it pushes (Team-lite).

ext.description: Extension container. Implementations MUST place non-standard fields here.
